changelog:
• Jam: joining by room code works again (Android 17 local network permission) and the Jam screen opens right after you join
• Jam: 'Listen on host's device' now shows the host's song with a live seek bar, and play/pause controls the host
• Jam: guests can play any song for everyone, plus Play next / Add to queue, with Spotify-style 'added by' avatars
• Jam: tighter online sync and lower battery use
• More accurate and faster Spotify playlist import
• Play all with shuffle on now starts from the first song
• Brand full player and loaders for each UI style, plus heat fixes
• Cleaner Audio Format Details and About screens
